decisions.decision: The default menu is ten commands in two groups, not the proposed six.
decisions.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-09-24 on the real rendered screen. /ant-init kept because it promises 'start a project' where /ant-go promises 'do this thing'; oracle, swarm and dream added because he actually reaches for them.

decisions.decision: The installed program was rebuilt and replaced before the fortnight, and the machine's shared command copy was re-published from this repo.
decisions.rationale: Owner approved both 2026-09-25 after being shown that the installed build predated the escalation fix and that /ant-go was missing from every project outside this repo. A local install and a local hub sync are not the npm/GitHub publish that D-01 and the milestone rules put out of scope.

decisions.decision: A one-line temporary catch-all goes into the owner's machine-wide instructions when the fortnight starts.
decisions.rationale: Owner approved 2026-09-25 after being shown the undercount risk: the recorder in this repo only fires when he comes here, so a blocker dealt with entirely inside another project would go uncounted and flatter the final verdict.
